capabilities: render grooph code blocks as graphs and operation maps
switch between views such as 3D stills, stairs, panes, spiral, rings, and columns
follow Obsidian theme colors and phone/wide layouts automatically
open the drawn document in the grooph web app from under each drawing
show an explanatory message when a block cannot be drawn
disambiguation: Not a graph view of vault links; it draws diagrams from grooph code blocks.
extras: Makes no network requests or telemetry; works on desktop and mobile; size limits are 500 nodes/2,000 edges per graph and 200 sessions/1,000 handoffs per map; no commands or settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw workflow diagrams from grooph documents or operation maps inside notes, only Mermaid syntax.

relations.evidence: the same drawing the grooph app and its command line make
Open in grooph opens the same document in the grooph app in your browser

requires.name: grooph app (browser) or command line to make documents

summary: Renders grooph code blocks as workflow diagrams—graphs and operation maps, flat or as 3D stills—styled to follow your Obsidian theme.
